description: Bike sharing - Noleggi is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Dati relativi al noleggio mensile del servizio bike-sharing. Sono riportati i chilometri percorsi, le ore di utilizzo e il numero di noleggi.I dati sono messi a disposizione da SRM l'agenzia per la mobilità e il trasporto pubblico del Comune di Bologna e della Città Metropolitana di Bologna. Coverage: Comune di Bologna. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Bologna. Its tags are N_A. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, JSON_LD, N3, PARQUET. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
